definition_facts.ja: fileWrapperをretainし、objc_super={incoming self,固定archive class}へinitを送る。super返値nilなら全filename/parser/ivar処理を飛ばし、通常終了でfileWrapperをreleaseしてnilを返す。
definition_facts.en: Retain fileWrapper and send init using objc_super={incoming self, fixed archive class}. A nil super result skips every filename/parser/ivar action and returns nil after normal fileWrapper release.

definition_facts.ja: filenameのpathExtensionをplistZ、次にplistと比較する。二つとも比較返値w0全体の0/非0で分岐し、bit0だけの検査ではない。
definition_facts.en: Compare filename.pathExtension first with plistZ, then plist. Both comparisons branch on the full w0 zero/nonzero result, not bit0 alone.

definition_facts.ja: plistZ枝はregularFileContentsへdecompressedDataを送り、nilならDocument Read Exception/Could not decompress archiveのraise:format:へfilenameを渡す。raiseが通常returnすればparserへ続く。圧縮algorithmやnative失敗動作は未読。
definition_facts.en: The plistZ path sends decompressedData to regularFileContents. Nil calls raise:format: with Document Read Exception and Could not decompress archive, passing filename. If raise returns normally, parsing continues. Compression algorithm and native failure behavior were not read.

definition_facts.ja: plist枝はregularFileContentsをそのまま使う。別suffixはNSAssertionHandler currentHandlerへhandleFailureInMethod:object:file:lineNumber:description:を送り、line236・source名・filenameを渡し、通常returnならdata=nilでparserへ進む。
definition_facts.en: The plist path uses regularFileContents directly. Other suffixes send NSAssertionHandler currentHandler a handleFailureInMethod:object:file:lineNumber:description: message with line236, source name and filename; normal return continues to the parser with nil data.

definition_facts.ja: NSPropertyListSerializationへdata x2、options=0 x3、format出力pointer x4、初期nilのerror出力pointer x5を渡す。この本文は返されたformat値を読まず、許可plist format/type/rangeを確定しない。
definition_facts.en: Send NSPropertyListSerialization data x2, options=0 x3, a format-out pointer x4 and an initially nil error-out pointer x5. This body never reads the returned format, so accepted plist formats/types/ranges remain unestablished.

definition_facts.ja: parser結果をretainして_topLevel(offset8)へ置き、旧値をreleaseする。nil結果はerror.localizedDescriptionをDocument Read Exceptionの%@ formatへ渡す。通常終了以外のcleanup/exception動作は未確認。
definition_facts.en: Retain the parser result, replace _topLevel at offset8 and release the prior value. A nil result supplies error.localizedDescription to the %@ format of Document Read Exception. Cleanup/exception behavior beyond normal return remains unverified.

definition_facts.ja: $versionをobjectForKeyedSubscript:で読み、integerValueの64bit返値を100000と比較し、不一致ならunsupported archive versionをraiseへ送る。class別version/rangeの検査ではなく、局所nil/type判定もない。
definition_facts.en: Look up $version by objectForKeyedSubscript:, compare the 64-bit integerValue result with100000, and send unsupported archive version to raise on mismatch. This is not a per-class-version/range check; there is no local nil/type branch.

definition_facts.ja: $objectsを_encodedObjects(offset16)、$topを_rootProperties(offset24)へretain/storeし、fileWrapperをoffset40へstoreStrongする。前二つのnonnilだけを要求し、NSArray/NSDictionaryの実型・要素/UID範囲はこの入口では検査しない。
definition_facts.en: Retain/store $objects into _encodedObjects at offset16 and $top into _rootProperties at offset24, then storeStrong fileWrapper at offset40. Only nonnil of the first two is required; actual NSArray/NSDictionary types and element/UID ranges are not checked by this entry.

definition_facts.ja: WsKeyboardLayer比較はw0のbit0 setでMAKeyboardLayerを選び、WsDirectToChannelMIDIParameterMapping比較はw0全体非0でMAChannelMIDIParameterMappingを選ぶ。返すのはimport class pointerに対するobjc_opt_classの実返値。
definition_facts.en: A set bit0 of the WsKeyboardLayer comparison selects MAKeyboardLayer; nonzero full w0 of the WsDirectToChannelMIDIParameterMapping comparison selects MAChannelMIDIParameterMapping. The returned class source is the actual objc_opt_class result on the imported class pointer.

definition_facts.ja: alias以外はNSKeyedUnarchiver classForClassName:を先に呼び、nonnil返値を使う。nilならincoming classNameをNSClassFromStringへ渡し、その実返値x0をretain/saveして返す。入力文字列を返すC表示は採用しない。
definition_facts.en: Outside the aliases, call NSKeyedUnarchiver classForClassName: first and use its nonnil result. On nil, pass incoming className to NSClassFromString, then retain/save/return its actual x0 result. The C display that appears to return the input string is rejected.

definition_facts.ja: classForClassName:の宣言返値はClass(#)。この本文に返Classのsubclass/security/acceptance/非nil保証はなく、native登録名・NSClassFromStringの解決動作や実効dispatchは未確認。
definition_facts.en: classForClassName: declares a Class (#) result. This body provides no returned-class subclass/security/acceptance or nonnil guarantee. Native registration/NSClassFromString resolution and effective dispatch remain unverified.

definition_facts.ja: _decodeDecodableObject:はincoming dictionaryの$classを読み、archive selfへ_decodedObject:を送り、その返値をself classForClassName:へ渡す。class keyと解決済Classを区別する。
definition_facts.en: _decodeDecodableObject: reads $class from the incoming dictionary, sends it to archive self via _decodedObject:, then passes that result to self classForClassName:. The encoded class key and resolved Class are distinct.

definition_facts.ja: 解決済Classをobjc_allocへ渡してallocated objectをx22へ保存する。固定proxy class25be290へdecoderWithDict:andCVArchive:を送り、x2は元dictionary x19、x3はarchive self x21。この本文はfactory内部を読まない。
definition_facts.en: Pass the resolved Class to objc_alloc and save the allocated object in x22. Send decoderWithDict:andCVArchive: to fixed proxy class25be290, with original dictionary x19 in x2 and archive self x21 in x3. The factory body was not read.

definition_facts.ja: factoryのdecoder返値をretainし、allocated object x22のinitWithCoder:へx2として渡す。initializerの実返値をx22へ置き、通常のrelease後にそのobject結果を返す。C表示で失われたalloc返値とfactory receiverを命令で補う。
definition_facts.en: Retain the factory decoder result and pass it as x2 to initWithCoder: on allocated object x22. Save the actual initializer result in x22 and return that object after normal releases. Assembly restores the allocation result and factory receiver obscured by C.

definition_facts.ja: 200Bのdecodable本文にnil/type/class-subclass/contains/error条件分岐はない。入力や生成decoderの実受理、init失敗、上流のtype選択、native failure、例外cleanupはこの本文だけでは確定しない。
definition_facts.en: The 200 B decodable body has no nil/type/class-subclass/contains/error conditional branch. Actual input/generated-decoder acceptance, initializer failure, upstream type selection, native failure and exception cleanup are not established by this body alone.

definition_facts.ja: valueForKey:は_rootPropertiesのincoming key raw値がnonnilならself _decodedObject:結果を返し、raw値nilならobjc_super={self,固定archive class}でsuper valueForKey:へ同じkeyを渡す。decode結果nil時のsuper再fallbackはない。
definition_facts.en: valueForKey: returns self _decodedObject: of a nonnil raw value under the incoming key in _rootProperties. A nil raw value sends the same key to super valueForKey: using objc_super={self, fixed archive class}. A nil decoded result does not trigger a second super fallback.

definition_facts.ja: rootPropertiesは_rootProperties.countをcapacityにNSMutableDictionaryを作り、元の_rootPropertiesのkeysをfast enumeration（要求batch16）する。生の元辞書をそのまま返すgetterではない。
definition_facts.en: rootProperties creates NSMutableDictionary with capacity _rootProperties.count and fast-enumerates the original keys with requested batch16. It does not simply return the raw original dictionary.

definition_facts.ja: 各keyで元辞書からraw値を引き、archive self _decodedObject:へ渡し、返値を同じkeyで新辞書のsetObject:forKeyedSubscript:へ直接送る。返値nilの局所gateはなく、native setterのnil動作は未確認。
definition_facts.en: For each key, fetch the original raw value, pass it to archive self _decodedObject:, and send its result directly to the new dictionary through setObject:forKeyedSubscript: under the same key. No local nil-result gate exists; native setter behavior on nil is unverified.

definition_facts.ja: rootPropertiesはenumeration mutationを検知するとobjc_enumerationMutationを呼び、batchとkeyを反復する。末尾のstack guard不一致はstack_chk_failへ進む。これらをarchiveの型/range/error検査や全cleanupの保証として数えない。
definition_facts.en: rootProperties calls objc_enumerationMutation on detected enumeration mutation and repeats keys/batches. A mismatched final stack guard calls stack_chk_fail. These are not archive type/range/error validation or a guarantee of complete cleanup.

definition_facts.ja: 固定5本文のcontainer入口・Class解決・decodable/KVC/root辞書の読出しを照合した。native/callee内部、実effective dispatch、受理archive実型、roundtrip/保存/再読込/Undo/製品capabilityは未確認。
definition_facts.en: Five fixed bodies establish the checked container entry, Class resolution and decodable/KVC/root dictionary reads. Native/callee internals, effective dispatch, actual accepted archive types, roundtrip/save/reload/Undo and product capabilities remain unverified.

decompiler_pitfalls: classForClassName C appears to return its input after NSClassFromString; ASM returns the actual native x0 result.
Alias C appears to return the imported class pointer; ASM returns objc_opt_class x0.
_decodeDecodableObject C loses objc_alloc result and factory receiver; ASM separates allocated resolved-class object from fixed proxy Class.
initWithFileWrapper C invents an extra old-field argument for $top lookup and in_x7 for assertion formatting; ASM passes one x2 key and explicit variadic filename on stack.
Four error formats are UTF16LE CFStrings with flags0x7d0; a flags0x7c8-only ASCII reader omits them.
